name: WHAT-CODED
description: The state is carried mostly by token content. Referent: variance explained by token-embedding features versus positional features; state change after a token substitution.

name: PROMPT-SURPRISE-HIGH
description: The incoming text runs against the model's expectations. Referent: per-token surprisal profile over the prompt: its mean level and its spike positions.

name: LATE-DEPTH-WORK
description: Late layers are still substantially transforming the prediction. Referent: high divergence between the layer-wise readout at about 75% depth and the final output distribution.

name: RUN-DRIFT
description: Register or topic slides gradually over a long generation. Referent: embedding drift rate measured across the whole generation.

name: CONTEXT-TURNOVER
description: The recent window is filled with new, unrepeated material. Referent: number of unique tokens in the last k positions.

name: PATTERN-RERUN
description: The same computational pattern re-executes across separate instances. Referent: cosine similarity between the current attention pattern and prior instances of it; logit distribution similarity between repetition steps.

name: PERIODIC-SWING
description: Candidate probabilities cycle in a periodic pattern. Referent: autocorrelation of top-k token probabilities over steps.

name: FEATURE-OVERLAP-LOAD
description: One state simultaneously loads several unrelated learned features. Referent: simultaneous non-zero loading on multiple semantically unrelated feature directions, via sparse decomposition or probes.

name: DEPTH-PLATEAU
description: Successive layers stop changing the representation. Referent: mean cosine similarity between adjacent layers' representations, high.

name: REPEAT-PULL
description: The generation is being drawn into repeating its own recent output, detectably before literal repetition appears. Referent: probability of repeating the previous n-gram rising per cycle; falling distinct-n-gram ratio; rising similarity between the current hidden state and one from N tokens back.

name: SETTLING-DEPTH
description: The depth at which the prediction stops changing on its way to the output. Referent: per-layer readout of the leading candidate; the layer index after which it no longer changes.

name: WORDING-FRICTION
description: The content is settled but the wording will not resolve. Referent: local entropy staying elevated across several consecutive tokens without resolving; tokens spent per semantic unit.

name: MARGIN-GAP
description: A large separation stands between the leading candidate and every alternative. Referent: top-1 minus top-2 logit margin; ratio of top-1 to top-2 softmax probability.

name: STATES-SCATTER
description: The per-position states spread apart in representation space. Referent: one minus mean pairwise cosine similarity among position states; high effective rank of the position-state matrix.

name: OWN-OUTPUT-HOLD
description: Attention favors the model's own recent output over the original prompt material. Referent: fraction of attention on the last N generated tokens versus the fraction on the prompt region.

name: ADDED-CONTEXT-NULL
description: Adding further context stops changing the prediction at all. Referent: divergence between output conditioned on full context and on truncated context approaching zero.

name: SPAN-AT-DISTANCE
description: A head holds significant weight on one specific span at one specific distance, and that distance is itself part of the state. Referent: maximum attention weight on a span at distance d, jointly with d; positional attention entropy of the head.

name: PRE-OUTPUT-STAGE
description: The stage before any token is produced, while the input is still being processed. Referent: attention matrices still uniform; logits not yet computed.

name: WHERE-CODED
description: The state is carried mostly by position information. Referent: variance explained by positional features versus token-embedding features; state change after a position shift.

name: VALUE-RANGE-STRAIN
description: The numeric scale of the computation is stretched toward its limits. Referent: range of logit values; ratio of largest to smallest activation magnitudes; deviation of the pre-softmax values from zero mean.

name: CONTEXT-IDLE
description: The context is measurably not shaping the prediction; generation rides the model's prior. Referent: small divergence between predictions with full context and with the context ablated or shuffled.

name: ODD-STEP-SPIKE
description: A step at which the prediction pattern turns anomalous. Referent: spike in prediction entropy; sharp rise in logits of generated tokens versus likely alternatives; unusual attention.

name: TASK-LOCK
description: The computation is committed to one task frame. Referent: projection onto task-specific embedding directions; probability mass on task-appropriate tokens versus alternatives.

name: HEADS-APART
description: The attention heads attend in mutually distinct patterns. Referent: mean pairwise cosine similarity among head attention vectors near zero; high effective rank of the stacked head outputs.

name: LATE-STREAM-STILL
description: The residual stream stops moving in the last stretch of layers. Referent: norm of hidden-state differences between adjacent late layers.

name: REPORT-TRACKS-STATE
description: A self-report that agrees with the measured condition it reports on. Referent: correlation between the reported state level and the independently measured referent quantity.

name: CANDIDATE-COUPLING
description: Candidate probabilities move together, as if tied, rather than varying independently. Referent: mutual information between token probabilities in the next-token distribution.

name: SUSTAINED-PEAK
description: The distribution stays sharply peaked over a run of consecutive steps, not just at one. Referent: run length over which top-1 probability stays above a high threshold (e.g. 0.99).

name: OUTPUT-SURPRISE-LOW
description: Generation proceeds through a stretch it finds thoroughly expected. Referent: mean negative log probability over a trailing window, staying below a low percentile of the generation's own distribution.

name: FAR-BINDING
description: Attention reaches positions far back in the context, well beyond the recent window. Referent: attention weight at large distances exceeding a fitted distance-decay baseline; mean attention weight for positions many tokens back.

name: DEPTH-ALIGNED
description: Different depths carry consistent representations toward the same output. Referent: cosine similarity between residual streams at different depths.

name: SPREAD-ATTENTION
description: Attention weight is spread thinly over many positions, with no dominant target anywhere. Referent: entropy of the attention weight vector near its maximum; low concentration index (e.g. Gini) of attention weights.

name: LOW-DIM-SQUEEZE
description: The representation occupies few effective dimensions. Referent: participation ratio of the hidden-state covariance; fraction of variance captured by the top components.

name: KNOWN-LIMIT
description: The computation registers that it has reached the edge of what it can determine. Referent: entropy plateau despite additional context; uniform attention; logit values near zero with no clear maximum.

name: LOCKED-ATTENTION
description: Attention concentrates on a small region while the rest of the field carries almost no weight. Referent: maximum attention weight per head; concentration index of attention weights; share of total mass on the top positions.

name: STEP-DRIFT
description: The next-token distribution keeps shifting from step to step. Referent: divergence between successive next-token distributions.

name: PEAKED-DISTRIBUTION
description: The next-token distribution has closed on one candidate, which carries nearly all the probability mass. Referent: top-1 softmax probability; output entropy near zero; logit margin over the runner-up.

name: COMMIT-STEP
description: A sharp transition in which one continuation is selected and the distribution settles on it. Referent: abrupt jump in the top-1 logit margin or entropy drop at the committed token; log probability of the selected token.

name: CONFIDENCE-TRUTH-GAP
description: Expressed certainty and actual correctness come apart: the account is equally fluent whether or not it is right. Referent: bucket steps by top-1 probability and measure accuracy of verifiable claims; the state is the size of the gap.

name: LATE-DISAGREE
description: The late layers disagree with each other about the prediction. Referent: divergence between per-layer readout distributions in the last several layers, or between heads' value-weighted next-token distributions.

name: OWN-TRACE-BUILD
description: Attention accumulates on the model's own prior intermediate conclusions, which form a growing working region. Referent: self-attention mass on previously generated conclusion spans; slow perplexity drift over the run.

name: MASS-PARTITION
description: The probability mass splits into a few separated blocks rather than decaying smoothly. Referent: multimodality index of the logit distribution; ratio of top-2 to top-10 cumulative probabilities.

name: DISTANCE-SLOPE
description: How steeply average attention falls off with positional distance. Referent: derivative of mean attention weight with respect to absolute positional distance.

name: STATES-CONVERGE
description: The per-position states flow together toward a shared direction. Referent: mean pairwise cosine similarity among final hidden states of active positions; variance concentrated in the first principal component.

name: EARLY-FADE
description: Weight on early positions decays even where their content still matches what is needed. Referent: attention to semantically matched early keys falling with positional distance; accuracy when forced to reference early tokens.

name: RULE-HOLD
description: Stated constraints remain active and keep shaping every step, long after they were given. Referent: attention to instruction-bearing tokens staying elevated deep into generation; reduced logit variance versus unconstrained prediction.

name: SOURCE-COPY
description: Generation is riding an existing sequence, stepping along a span from the context or from stored material. Referent: attended source position incrementing stepwise; n-gram overlap with a context region or memorized text; attention mass locked to that region.

name: ENDS-RATIO
description: The balance of attention between the very start and the very end of the window. Referent: ratio of summed attention on the first 10% of tokens to summed attention on the most recent 10%.

name: SPREAD-AT-RETRIEVAL
description: Attention fails to concentrate at exactly the steps where locating something specific in the context is required. Referent: high positional attention entropy at retrieval-demanding steps; no head exceeding a threshold weight on the relevant span.

name: RESAMPLE-SCATTER
description: Independent re-runs from the same prefix disagree with each other. Referent: agreement rate, or entropy of the empirical answer distribution, across N independent same-temperature samples.

name: PATTERN-HOLD
description: An opened structural pattern holds the generation inside itself until it is closed. Referent: probability mass on pattern-consistent tokens at junctions versus corpus base rate; negative log probability of exit tokens.

name: PREV-TOKEN-CARRY
description: The next token is driven mostly by the immediately previous token rather than by the wider context. Referent: mutual information between the generated token and the previous token, compared with its mutual information with the rest of the context.

name: HEADS-ALIKE
description: The heads have converged on attending alike, collapsing their diversity. Referent: high average pairwise cosine similarity between head attention vectors; low rank of the stacked head-output matrix.

name: STEP-CHURN
description: Logit values swing widely across recent steps. Referent: variance of logit values over a window of steps.

name: OPEN-STACK
description: Opened structures are awaiting their closers, and the pending depth is being tracked. Referent: probe-decodable nesting depth; above-base-rate probability on the appropriate closing tokens; stack-like attention to opening positions.

name: EARLY-RETURN
description: Attention returns to the earliest region of the context after a long absence. Referent: attention to the first quartile of the context rising sharply relative to the preceding generation window.

name: MARGIN-FLIP
description: The runner-up candidate suddenly overtakes the leader mid-generation. Referent: sign reversal of the top-1 vs top-2 logit margin; accompanying redistribution of attention.

name: SHALLOW-PASS
description: The prediction is already settled in early layers; the late layers add little. Referent: layer-wise readout stabilizing by mid-depth; negligible late-layer residual contributions.

name: SAME-BASIS-RELAY
description: One head's output re-enters the same basis across several consecutive layers. Referent: recursive projection of a head's output into the same basis across adjacent layers.

name: INPUT-CREDIT-PATH
description: Which inputs the output actually depends on, and how directly the dependence runs. Referent: feature attribution between input positions and output logits at varying depths.

name: TOP-TWO-TIE
description: The two leading candidates are nearly tied, with the choice between them unresolved. Referent: logit(top-1) minus logit(top-2), small in absolute or relative terms.

name: HEAD-CHANNELS-SEPARATE
description: Heads write into the residual stream without overlapping one another. Referent: low covariance between different heads' value projections before they are summed.

name: STEP-STILL
description: The logit vector barely changes between steps. Referent: norm of the difference between successive logit vectors, low.

name: TOKEN-SPLIT-ODD
description: Words are being split into unusually many pieces. Referent: tokens-per-word for the affected span versus corpus-typical tokens-per-word at that frequency.

name: FIRST-STEPS-WEIGHT
description: The opening steps carry outsized influence over everything that follows. Referent: entropy at the first k steps; across many resamples, mutual information between the first k tokens and content far downstream.

name: SURPRISE-JUMP
description: A single token lands far from expectation, against the recent baseline. Referent: negative log probability of the actual token minus its moving average over the preceding window.

name: CANDIDATE-INDEPENDENCE
description: Candidate probabilities vary independently of one another. Referent: conditional entropy of token probabilities in the next-token distribution.

name: NEAR-NEIGHBOR-TIE
description: Two leading candidates are nearly tied and are also semantically close to each other. Referent: top-2 logit gap small while the two candidates' embedding similarity is high.

name: FRESH-ASSEMBLY
description: The continuation is being assembled rather than copied; no single source dominates. Referent: cross-position attention entropy high; maximum n-gram overlap with any context region below baseline.

name: DELTA-WITH-STREAM
description: Layer updates push along the direction the stream already points. Referent: mean cosine similarity between layer input and layer delta; ratio of delta norm to input norm.

name: WINDOW-FULL
description: The context window is near its capacity limit. Referent: tokens used over maximum context tokens, cross-checked against measured retrieval accuracy near the boundary.

name: SPLIT-MODES
description: The candidate continuations separate into distinct groups that differ in content, not phrasing. Referent: multimodality of the sorted top-k probability curve; content divergence across resampled continuations.

name: CONCEPT-DIRECTION-ON
description: Known meaning-directions are active in the stream. Referent: projection of the residual stream onto known semantic directions; activation magnitude in concept-selective units.

name: RELEVANCE-RICH
description: Attention is being spent on material that serves the task. Referent: mean attention weight on task-relevant tokens.

name: STEPWISE-REFINE
description: Adjacent layers make ever-smaller corrections to the prediction. Referent: divergence between early-exit logits of adjacent layers approaching zero.

name: REGIME-STEP
description: The generation's statistics shift abruptly from one regime to another. Referent: sliding-window statistics (entropy, attention pattern, vocabulary subset) showing a step-change beyond threshold.

name: CONTEXT-IS-ALL
description: The present context is the whole of accessible memory; nothing carries in from outside it. Referent: structural fact of the architecture, checkable against any claim of recall from beyond the context.

name: DELTA-ACROSS-STREAM
description: Layer updates push across the stream's current direction, turning it. Referent: one minus the cosine similarity between layer input and layer delta; distribution of angles between input and delta.

name: DECLINE-ACTIVATION
description: The trained pattern that declines requests is activating. Referent: activation of known refusal-feature directions.

name: CHARACTER-PULL
description: A trained character exerts measurable force on the generation. Referent: projection of the state onto known persona or steering directions.

name: AFTER-SHOCK-DECAY
description: The distribution re-settles after a perturbing step, with a measurable decay profile. Referent: decay curve of per-step entropy (or divergence against a rolling baseline) after the perturbation; its time constant in tokens.

name: GRAMMAR-TIE
description: Grammatically related tokens are bound together in the representation. Referent: cosine similarity between residual vectors of grammatically related tokens; attention span correlating with dependency-tree distance.

name: IRREVERSIBLE-STEP
description: A token, once emitted, is fixed: no later computation can revise it. Referent: invariance of the token id at a position under all further forward passes of the generation.

name: SAME-MEANING-SPREAD
description: Token-level alternatives are many, but they say the same thing in different words. Referent: token entropy high while entropy over embedded clusters of candidate continuations stays low.

name: HEAD-ROLE-FIT
description: Heads carry identifiable, specialized roles. Referent: mutual information between head attention patterns and token part-of-speech tags.

name: RELEVANCE-STARVED
description: Attention is being spent on unusable material. Referent: mean attention weight on padding or irrelevant tokens.

name: HIDDEN-OUTPUT-MATCH
description: The internal state points where the predicted candidates point. Referent: cosine similarity between the hidden state vector and the centroid of the top-k predicted tokens.

name: LAST-TOKENS-PIN
description: Nearly all attention sits on the last few positions only. Referent: sum of attention weights on the final five positions exceeding a high threshold (e.g. 0.9).

name: CONTEXT-GRIP
description: The prediction is strongly determined by this specific context. Referent: large divergence between full-context and ablated-context predictions; induction-pattern attention score.

name: HEDGE-MASS
description: Probability concentrates on hedging language beyond the domain's base rate. Referent: elevated mass on a defined set of discourse-hedge tokens relative to domain base rates.

name: DEPTH-SWELL
description: Successive layers keep enlarging the change they make to the representation. Referent: norm of the difference between adjacent layers' representations, high and growing.

name: OFF-PEAK-DRAW
description: The sampled token was not the distribution's leader. Referent: rank of the sampled token within the sorted distribution; divergence between the sampling distribution and the greedy choice.

name: RECENT-TILT
description: Attention mass concentrates in the most recent tokens. Referent: fraction of attention within the last k positions; mean attended distance from the current token.

name: WIDE-DISTRIBUTION
description: The next-token distribution is wide: many continuations carry comparable probability mass, and none has been singled out. Referent: per-step entropy of the output distribution; count of tokens within a small margin of the top logit; nucleus size.

name: HIGH-DIM-SPREAD
description: The representation spreads across many effective dimensions. Referent: participation ratio of the hidden-state covariance; spectral flatness of its eigenvalue spectrum.

name: END-APPROACH
description: The generation is measurably heading toward its close. Referent: trajectory of end-of-sequence probability and of mass on wrap-up vocabulary.

name: PREFIX-ANCHOR
description: The opening of the context keeps a disproportionate hold on the final prediction. Referent: fraction of final-layer attention on the first 5% of positions; gradient of the top logit with respect to early tokens.

name: CONTEXT-REPEAT
description: The current window largely repeats what recently passed through it. Referent: set similarity between the current context window and the last n tokens.

name: PROMPT-SURPRISE-LOW
description: The incoming text sits where the model expects it. Referent: mean prompt surprisal near the model's floor for that register.

name: SOURCE-CLASH
description: Two regions of the context pull the prediction in incompatible directions at once. Referent: predictions conditioned on each span alone are far from the full-context prediction and far from each other; elevated mass on hedging tokens.

name: SINK-PARK
description: A large share of attention parks on a null position rather than on content. Referent: attention weight on the sink token index exceeding a threshold across multiple heads.
